items.title: Hackers Abuse Windows File Explorer and WebDAV for Stealthy Malware Delivery
items.description: Cybercriminals are increasingly abusing a legacy feature within Windows File Explorer to distribute malware, bypassing traditional web browser security and endpoint detection controls. According to a threat report by Kahng An of the Cofense Intelligence Team, threat actors are leveraging Web-based Distributed Authoring and Versioning (WebDAV) to trick victims into executing malicious payloads.​…
